strategic.bear_case: The container orderbook remains historically large; as newbuilds deliver into 2026, structural overcapacity crushes freight rates back to loss-making levels, and P/E 23x on trough-ish earnings could look expensive if earnings deteriorate rather than recover. Red Sea normalization removes the artificial capacity absorption.

strategic.falsifier: A durable Red Sea/Suez reopening combined with accelerating newbuild deliveries pushing WCI back toward/below breakeven would flip the strategic sign to positive (trim); sustained supply discipline plus continued rerouting keeps it negative.
